Responsibilities

The high-performing Global Monetization Strategy & Operations organization provides business critical insights using data analytics, ensures cross functional alignment of goals and execution, and helps teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward. We stay focused on aligning the highest-level company priorities with effective day-to-day operations, and help evolve early stage ideas into future-growth initiatives.

The System Strategy & Operations team under Global Monetization Strategy & Operations is responsible for standardizing processes, driving product adoption, user satisfaction and loyalty of our transaction platform, building relationships with regional cross-functional teams, managing market voice, and influencing the Product team with market feedback & insights.

About This Position
The System Strategy & Operations team is seeking a Global Product Operations Manager Intern to join us. The role will focus on client incentive systems and processes. You will work with the product team, sales and clients, finance team and other cross-functional teams to develop and activate the client incentive system. The ideal candidate must demonstrate strong global business acumen, a passion & vision for transaction systems, strong digital advertising and product positioning skillsets, exhibit excellent problem solving & analytical mindset and communication skills, be able to thrive in an ambiguous environment and have strong leadership to drive impact across xFn teams for the business.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date in 2026 Fall. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

Responsibilities:
- System Operations & Execution: Assist in the end-to-end operation of the client incentive system and the monthly settlement/payout process to ensure timing and accuracy.
- Data Analysis & Quality Assurance: Help verify and audit incentive calculation results; identify data anomalies or calculation gaps under the guidance of mentors.
- Requirements Gathering: Support the team in translating Latam regional business needs into system product requirements; assist in writing product requirement documents (PRDs).
- User Enablement & Adoption: Help drive the adoption of incentive tools and dashboards among key users (Sales, Clients, Finance) by creating training materials, marketing content, and sales enablement documentation.
- Issue Resolution: Act as a key contact point to address daily system queries from both internal sales representatives and external clients, explaining calculation logic clearly.
- Dashboarding: Support the building and maintenance of client incentive BI dashboards to visualize key metrics for regional teams.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in progress (preferably in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related fields).
- Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to simplify complex messages for different audiences; A fast learner with a strong sense of ownership; comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and multicultural environment.
- Can commit to at least 3 days per week for a minimum of 6 months
- Proficiency in Chinese and English is required to collaborate with global partners and key stakeholders based in Mandarin-speaking markets, where Mandarin is a primary working language.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Prior internship experience in product operations, data analysis, or business operations is preferred.
- Strong analytical skills; proficiency in SQL is highly preferred; experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) or programming languages (Python, R) is a strong plus.

Job Description

TD Securities Technology offers a FinTech Summer Internship Program that is an unparalleled experience – where you’ll gain valuable insight into our vision to Build The Better Bank, while also strengthening the core skills and knowledge you’ll need to launch a successful career.

Software Engineer Rotational Program Experience

Our 10 week non-rotational program consists of:

- A fun-filled, high-energy introduction to TD
- A variety of professional experiences, including substantive technical assignments to help grow and expand your technical skill sets
- Professional development training
- Extensive networking opportunities
- Interaction and dedicated chats with senior leaders
- A dedicated support network, including a formal peer-mentoring program
- Brand new modern office with sitting/standing adjustable desks, foosball table, air hockey, ping pong, cold brew coffee on tap, weekly ice cream socials, happy hours and more!
- An active role in community service projects

How You Will Contribute

- Participate on a team with targeted deliverables, working on initiatives designed to develop new functionality, improve processes, systems and applications which support our key businesses at TD Securities.
- Produce high quality code for various initiatives and ensure defect free programming by testing and debugging using available/appropriate tools and participate in peer code reviews
- Develop new applications/solutions with consistent quality standards; provide code maintenance and support during testing cycles and post-production deployment
- Work with technologies such as: JavaScript, Angular, React, SQL, NoSql, C++, C#, Java, Scala, Python, NodeJS, RESTful APIs, Hadoop stack (HBase, HDFS), Spark API (DataFrame, DataSet), enterprise integration patterns and messaging systems (Kafka, ZeroMQ), etc

- Summer Software Engineers typically work on Financial Securities-related Technology projects such as: trade capture, real-time derivatives pricing & risk mgmt., PNL, quant modeling, algo execution & hedging, big data analytics, electronic trading & STP, valuations, etc

- Summer Software Engineers will typically learn about financial products (no prior finance knowledge is required!) such as: equity derivatives, interest rate derivatives, FX spot & derivatives trading (market making, algo trading & hedging), fixed income, credit derivatives, commodity derivatives, mortgage-backed securities (MBS), etc

Beyond the Internship

Our Summer Internship Program at TD Securities serves as a feeder program for our FinTech Software Engineer Rotation Program upon graduation. Each year several high-performing interns receive full-time offers for the rotation program upon completion of their summer internship. The Rotation Program is a competitive program in which recent grads rotate to 4 Financial Technology teams within their first 2 years at TD Securities. This program provides exposure to a variety of technology areas and businesses within TD Securities.

The program provides an on-boarding curriculum, mentoring, rotational training, and on the job experience in the core activities of TD Securities Financial Technology as well as ongoing leadership development throughout the rotational period & career. Our Technology leaders are committed to people development, career advancement, and value diversity and inclusion.

- Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math or Technology Sciences
- Strong conceptual, analytical and problem solving skills; basic knowledge of SDLC
- Excellent verbal & written communication with ability to work effectively in a team environment
- Ability to develop good business relationships with customers, business partners and stakeholders
- Familiarity and strength in 1 or more of the following: JavaScript, Angular, React, SQL, NoSql, C++, C#, Java, Scala, Python, NodeJS, RESTful APIs, Hadoop stack (HBase, HDFS), Spark API (DataFrame, DataSet), enterprise integration patterns and messaging systems (Kafka, ZeroMQ), etc.

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.

Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.

Designers at Palantir develop a deep understanding of the problems our customers face while solving some of the world’s most unique challenges. Our mission is to build generalizable and scalable solutions that elegantly handle the complexity of these problem spaces.

Core Responsibilities

- Interaction and visual design. As a product designer, you'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience designing and prototyping using tools such as Figma.

- User research. We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. You'll often visit customer offices to interview and learn from the users we serve. You'll pair qualitative methods (e.g. scripted usability tests and contextual inquiry) with quantitative information, like product and usage metrics.

- Deliver and communicate designs in close collaboration. We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers and product managers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.

- Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies.

- Designers at Palantir have great autonomy over their work, so a wide skill set is necessary. However, many designers on the team are also passionate experts in one area. You might be the kind of designer who ships code every week, or the kind of designer who shares detailed user research findings with your team.

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build great relationships with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders, and convey and debate design rationale.

- High empathy and dedication to the user, striving to understand and empower them.

- An iterative design process. You validate your ideas early (with stakeholders and users) and are thoughtful and intentional in seeking and responding to feedback. You move fast, listen, and adapt. You rapidly incorporate feedback, and prioritize collaboration. You are adept at giving and receiving critiques.

- Excitement for solving hard, complex problems. You are excited to design for technically complex and data dense interfaces. You thrive in an environment where you can jump into deep subject matter expertise to define simple, approachable, yet still powerful product experiences.

- Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed.

- Must be planning on graduating in 2027.

- Active US Security clearance or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance.
